description: This file defines testing utilities for OpenTelemetry SDK spans, including SpanStub structures, conversion functions from ReadOnlySpan, and snapshot implementations.

classes.name: SpanStub
classes.description: A stand-in for a Span used for testing, containing span metadata and context.

classes.name: spanSnapshot
classes.description: A private struct implementing ReadOnlySpan interface for snapshotting SpanStub data.

methods.name: SpanStubsFromReadOnlySpans
methods.description: Creates a list of SpanStubs from a slice of ReadOnlySpan.

methods.name: SpanStubFromReadOnlySpan
methods.description: Converts a ReadOnlySpan into a SpanStub.

methods.name: Snapshot
methods.description: Returns a read-only snapshot of the SpanStub.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the span snapshot.

methods.name: SpanContext
methods.description: Returns the span context of the span snapshot.

methods.name: Parent
methods.description: Returns the parent span context.

methods.name: SpanKind
methods.description: Returns the kind of span.

methods.name: StartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the span.

methods.name: EndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time of the span.

methods.name: Attributes
methods.description: Returns the attributes associated with the span.

methods.name: Links
methods.description: Returns the links associated with the span.

methods.name: Events
methods.description: Returns the events associated with the span.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Returns the status of the span.

methods.name: DroppedAttributes
methods.description: Returns the number of dropped attributes.

methods.name: DroppedLinks
methods.description: Returns the number of dropped links.

methods.name: DroppedEvents
methods.description: Returns the number of dropped events.

methods.name: ChildSpanCount
methods.description: Returns the count of child spans.

methods.name: Resource
methods.description: Returns the resource associated with the span.

methods.name: InstrumentationScope
methods.description: Returns the instrumentation scope.

methods.name: InstrumentationLibrary
methods.description: Returns the instrumentation library (deprecated).
